integrity: Exact-rational Darboux and Taylor interval code and four completed certificate outputs supplied. No claim of independence.
scientific_limitations: Only team sizes N=7,8,9,10 and an unspecified sufficiently small positive common resetting rate are proved.
No universal variance cutoff for larger N or finite-rate optimum is claimed.
The renewal transform and the mean threshold are established results; mathematical priority of evaluated fluctuation signs needs independent review.
title: Mean–variance opposition and a certified team-size switch under collective Brownian resetting
